title: Build the YAML LSP plugin in opum-marketplace (DEC-85 A)
description: opum-agent OPAG-947 dispatch of DEC-85 option A: build a config-only YAML LSP plugin in this marketplace matching the official LSP plugin pattern. Its lspServers entry runs yaml-language-server --stdio for .yaml and .yml; the plugin skill tells the user to run npm i -g yaml-language-server (unpinned as DEC-85 states; the fleet installs 1.24.0 per host, not this task). Stop before publication: release is tier 3 on the operator dialog. Pending design choices routed to opum-agent before build: plugin naming, the in-repo entry shape, and the check · manifests plus Codex generator amendments the in-repo entry needs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The plugin directory exists with its skill and README, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json lists the plugin with an inline lspServers stanza running yaml-language-server --stdio for .yaml and .yml, matching the official LSP plugin pattern.
The plugin skill tells the user to run npm i -g yaml-language-server.

claude plugin eval exits 0 on the suite at the fleet floor standards: at least one should-NOT-fire case, at least one outcome grader per case, runs 3 minimum, ablation with-without, sonnet-tier judge; the result is recorded on the task with run ids.

All repository checks pass locally under the amended machinery: check · manifests admits the in-repo entry, generate-codex-marketplace --check exits 0 with the Codex mirror carrying the plugin, both federated checkers pass, the five test suites pass, and lore check plus lore agents --check exit 0.
The PR into dev carries the three required contexts completed green on its head SHA, and the task close rides in that PR.
README.md and CLAUDE.md are updated so the repository no longer claims it owns no plugin content directly, naming the YAML LSP plugin as the in-repo exception.

implementationNotes: Q1 answered by opum-agent 2026-09-30: the plugin name is yaml-lsp (13 of 13 official LSP entries are <language>-lsp; follows DEC-85 A). Inline entry shape and .yaml/.yml globs confirmed to conform as proposed. Q2 (in-repo entry with this repository's federated-only invariant amended, versus a new public repo) is the operator's call and has been routed by opum-agent to opum-doc as an A/B with the evidence, recommendation A first. Build held until Q2 is answered: no changes to check · manifests, scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs, README.md or CLAUDE.md in the interim.
